item.title: Searching for a font that looks vertically 'squished'
item.description:
Hello everyone,

I’m looking for a font that appears to be flattened or squished, as if a big boulder were sitting on top of it.

Does anyone know of a font that achieves this look?

Thanks in advance to anyone who replies!
